arms.label: Ensitrelvir
arms.description: Participants will receive multiple oral doses of a combined oral contraceptive (COC) (EE and DRSP) once daily for 24 days (Days 1 to 24) (in the fasted state on Days 18 to 24) in the morning. Participants will also receive ensitrelvir high dose on Day 20 and multiple oral doses of ensitrelvir low dose once daily on Days 21 to 24 in the fasted state.
